The '''Mark M Guard Droid''' was a model of [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]]-shaped [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] that was used by the forces of the [[Specialists]], a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] unit. Mark M Guard Droids were deployed under the control of [[QO-99]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]] during the [[Conquest of Makeb]].
